additional_info.body:
Hello Grégoire, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
It seems there is a modbus communication error which needs to be checked on site.
We will forward this information to the Field service team and they will troubleshoot the error and provide a solution.
As soon as they are assigned, they will reach out to you.
One thing to keep in mind, there was an error on DC2 which related to a External Load Management System configuration. I removed it for the moment so that at least DC2 is able to charge.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0465338-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/S4170003529] Modbus connection interrupted CRM:00315003098
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0465338
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Kallista
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP/S4170003529
Charger ID / Serial No.:z8m93p
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: IMD_BC1 error Modbus not connected:
Check the following wires
Try swapping BC1 and BC2
If the error persists in BC1, replace it
If the error is now on BC2, then it's a wiring issue, we should check until the KF11.
If all wires check, try replacing the connector where the cables come in with a spare one from neighbour component
If nothing works, try replacing KF11.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
